versions.changelog:
- Added a "Start on APIDot" section with direct links for ClawHub users to reach the model page, docs, dashboard, and examples.
- No functional or API changes; documentation-only revision.
- Removed the file "skill-card.md" from the release.
- Clarified APIDot entry points for improved onboarding.

Initial release of APIDot Grok Imagine Image Quality API documentation skill.

- Provides comprehensive documentation routing for Grok Imagine Image Quality workflows via APIDot.
- Includes guidance on high-fidelity image generation, reference-guided editing, supported outputs, task_id, polling, and webhook use.
- Focuses on documentation and workflow notes only—no network requests, scripts, or credential storage.
- Strong emphasis on API key and data security best practices.
- Offers clear links to official APIDot docs, model pages, and examples.
